text:
alex_k: Quick crosswalk — status check on kernel + continuous-batching + KV warmup work. Can owners call out current milestone, blockers, and any dependency we should escalate?

maya_r: Kernel patch #412 landed yesterday but waiting on perf regression signoff from CI (observed 4-6% p50 increase on long-seq tests). I can run more microbenchmarks today.

chen_w: Continuous batching: feature branch has the new deadline heuristics and backpressure hook. Need a kernel handshake change (small API) to expose `can_batch` signal. Alex, do we have owners for kernel API change?

alex_k: I can own the kernel API handshake. Plan: add `can_batch(node_id)` + a short-lived feature flag. Timeline: prototype by EOD Wednesday, canary next week.

samir: KV warmup/eviction: experimenting with segmented prefetch windows. Found a case where cold-start plus aggressive prefetch oversubscribes GPU memory on 12GB nodes. Need to coordinate with infra for a temporary increased quota for canary. Lia, can you open a quota ticket?

lia_ops: opened infra ticket #INF-827 with requested bump for 24h canary. Pinged infra on slack.

maya_r: On the CI regression — initial triage points to FP16 matmul kernel fallback hitting a slower path for seq>2048. I pushed a debug build (w/ logging) to the perf-ci pool: `rbld/perf/fp16-debug-2024-09`. deploy-bot, can you run workload `longseq-kernel-10k` against that build?

deploy-bot: Scheduled job perf-run/longseq-kernel-10k on rbld/perf/fp16-debug-2024-09. Results ETA ~45m.

chen_w: If the kernel fallback is the cause, we should gate continuous-batching canary until we have either a micro-optim or a perf-safe fallback. Otherwise batches will push through slower path and hurt tail latency. Suggest two-phase canary: 1) kernel API + small batch sizes on canary; 2) lift limits if perf OK.

alex_k: Agreed. Two-phase canary. Phase 1 owners: kernel (alex_k), batching (chen_w), KV warmup (samir). Phase 1 checklist: feature-flagged handshake, canary node pool with quota INF-827, small-batch config, perf smoke test pass.

samir: I'll add the KV warmup config that caps prefetch to 256MB per model shard in canary. That should avoid the oversubscribe case.

maya_r: If the debug build passes perf-run, I can flip the canary tests to run full-seq workloads. If not, I'll bisect to the matmul kernel change.

lia_ops: INF-827 updated with canary node pool info and owner list. ETA for nodes to be provisioned: 3 hours.

alex_k: Blockers: (1) CI perf result (deploy-bot job), (2) infra quota (lia_ops), (3) small risk of API mismatch if we change kernel signature. Mitigations listed in checklist above. Anything else?

maya_r: One more: need a short doc snippet for rollout rollback criteria (p50/p95 regressions >5% or token-cost >2%). I'll draft in the canary runbook and post link.

chen_w: Also adding a test in runtime-integration that asserts `can_batch` returns false for incompatible node types. PR incoming: #589.

alex_k: Good. Owners, confirm you can hit the milestones: prototype handshake by Wed EOD (alex), kernel perf triage today (maya), canary quota provision in 3h (lia), batching PR + tests by tomorrow (chen), KV config for prefetch cap today (samir). Reply with :thumbsup: when ok.

maya_r: :thumbsup:

chen_w: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup: will push KV change in ~2h

lia_ops: :thumbsup: infra ticket updated; will escalate if provisioning stalls

alex_k: Great. I'll post the Phase 1 runbook once deploy-bot returns perf results. Keep this thread for async updates.

deploy-bot: perf-run/longseq-kernel-10k completed: p50 +1.1%, p95 +0.9% vs baseline. Full logs: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/2098765432.

maya_r: Thanks — numbers look within noise. I'll run one more debug with extended sampling overnight and then we can promote to Phase 2 config tomorrow morning.

chen_w: Moving forward with canary config change in 30m. I'll ping this thread when PR is merged.

alex_k: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker, drop @alex_k in channel and I'll re-prioritize.
